parole.testo: Back-formation from jaszczyk, from Russian я́щик (jáščik), from Old East Slavic аскъ (askŭ) or ꙗскъ (jaskŭ), from Old Norse askr (“wooden vessel”) or eski (“ashen box”).

parole.significato: knout (leather scourge used in imperial Russia)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian кнут (knut), from Old East Slavic кнутъ (knutŭ), from Old Norse knútr (“knot”).
